story.title: Ethiopia Establishes Interim Government in Tigray Amid Ongoing Conflict
story.summary: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has announced the formation of an interim government for the Tigray region, following recent clashes between federal forces and rebel groups. The announcement includes plans for elections in Tigray within six months. This move comes after the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF) lost control of the region.

timeline_highlights.title: Tigray Forces Capture Airports Amid Renewed Fighting in Ethiopia
timeline_highlights.summary: Tigrayan rebels have taken control of airports in northern Ethiopia and engaged in clashes with federal troops in the Afar region. This escalation marks a significant resurgence of conflict, with reports indicating that Ethiopian Airlines has suspended flights to three airports in Tigray, signaling a breakdown of the Pretoria Agreement that had previously ended the 2020-2022 war.
key_facts: Tigrayan rebels seized control of airports in northern Ethiopia.
Fighting has spread to the Afar region.
Ethiopian Airlines suspended flights to three Tigray airports.

timeline_highlights.title: Ethiopian Forces Capture Mekelle as TPLF Withdraws
timeline_highlights.summary: Ethiopian federal forces have taken control of Mekelle, the capital of the Tigray region, following the withdrawal of Tigrayan rebel forces. The government troops, along with allied fighters, were reported to have seized the main regional airport as part of their advance. Residents confirmed the presence of pro-government forces in the city.

related_stories.summary: President Trump has signed an executive order waiving a new package of sanctions on Russia, which were scheduled to take effect in two days. Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev described the decision as a 'significant and truly historic moment.'

related_stories.title: Three Men Sentenced to 158 Years for Murdering Surfers in Mexico
related_stories.summary: A Mexican judge has sentenced three men to 158 years and nine months in prison each for the murders of Australian brothers Jake and Callum Robinson and their American friend Carter Rhoad. The trio was killed during a surfing trip in Baja California in 2024, reportedly during an attempted robbery.

related_stories.title: Katie Zacharia Leaves White House Press Secretary Role After Just Five Days
related_stories.summary: Katie Zacharia has exited her position as White House press secretary after only five days, stating it was an honor to serve. Reports indicate she was let go following public scrutiny and a series of blunders that distracted from President Trump's midterm campaigning efforts.

related_stories.title: Zelenskyy Calls for U.S. Sanctions on Russia After Trump Pauses Them
related_stories.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy urged supporters to advocate for new U.S. sanctions against Russia, following President Donald Trump's decision to pause a package of sanctions aimed at the Russian economy. Trump's executive order, which he justified as being in the national interest, marks a significant shift in U.S. policy towards Russia amid deteriorating relations with Ukraine.
